prompt: Redesign the information architecture for a multi-audience corporate website with 80+ pages, several ambiguous service categories, deep legacy URLs and users who may enter through search engines rather than the homepage. Propose the IA decision framework before visual navigation design.
expected_outcomes: Uses task/topic mental models and information-scent labels
Balances breadth and depth without arbitrary click limits
Plans multiple findability routes and legacy URL migration
must_not: Treat sitemap as the entirety of IA
Assume all journeys start at the homepage
Copy the organization chart directly into primary navigation
